security.compat: Works with Google Authenticator / Microsoft Authenticator / 1Password
security.alertEnabled: Sign-in requires the 6-digit code from your authenticator. The current password is required to disable it.
security.alertDisabled: Once enabled, sign-in requires a dynamic code, greatly reducing password-leak risk. The secret is shown only once — keep it safe.
security.totpPlaceholder: Enter the current code from your authenticator
security.recoveryHint: Use them to sign in if the authenticator is lost; each works once
security.recoveryDesc: Recovery codes replace the 6-digit dynamic code at sign-in. Generating new codes invalidates the old ones immediately, and plaintext is shown only once. Print or store them offline, never in a shared folder.
security.kickDesc: Access and refresh tokens on that device are invalidated immediately and it must sign in again.
security.kickCurrentOk: Current session signed out; please sign in again
security.kickFail: Failed to sign the session out
security.securityHint: All devices must sign in again after signing out
security.securityDesc: Signing out all sessions bumps the account token version, invalidating access/refresh tokens on every device; this page returns to sign-in as well.
security.logoutAllDesc: Every device is signed out immediately and must re-authenticate.
security.logoutAllMsg: All sessions signed out; please sign in again
security.regenWarn: Generating new codes invalidates the existing ones immediately
security.saveWarn: Save these now: they cannot be viewed again after closing
security.needPasswordOrCode: Enter your current password or the 6-digit dynamic code
security.codeGenerated: New recovery codes generated; old codes are now invalid
security.copyFail: Copy failed; select the text and copy manually
security.totpEnabledMsg: Secret generated. Scan or enter it in your authenticator, then confirm with a dynamic code.
